retired_rows.label: spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores#1
retired_rows.source: Reads the measurement store selected by ``measurement_backend`` from :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`, merges cell/nucleus/pathogen/ cytoplasm feature tables, uses the wells marked as ``positive_control`` / ``negative_control`` (or an annotation column) as training labels, delegates fitting to :func:`ml_analysis`, and writes per-object predictions, permutation and feature-importance tables plus a plate heatmap into ``results/`` under the first source folder.
retired_rows.translation: Les mæligagnageymsluna sem valin er með ``measurement_backend`` úr :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`, sameinar eiginleikatöflur fyrir frumu/kjarna/sýkil/ umfrymi, notar brunnana sem merktir eru ``positive_control`` / ``negative_control`` (eða athugasemdadálk) sem þjálfunarmerki, felur :func:`ml_analysis` aðlögunina og skrifar spár fyrir hvern hlut, umröðunar- og eiginleikavægistöflur ásamt hitakorti plötunnar í ``results/`` undir fyrstu upprunamöppunni.
